name: Bear Naked Wood
old_description: Welcome to Bear Naked Wood, the ultimate destination for your back to nature needs
about:
Bear Naked Wood operates a 2,000-square-foot showroom and workshop in Fenton, Michigan. The company describes its mission as a legacy of returning to nature, creating custom live-edge furniture and handcrafted woodwork for homes and commercial spaces.

The shop provides full-service custom design, build, and installation of wood and epoxy pieces. Its capabilities include live-edge dining tables, conference tables, epoxy river tables, kitchen and bar countertops, floating shelves, fireplace mantels, charcuterie boards, and commercial wood features. The team works with quality hardwoods, epoxy finishes, and reclaimed wood inventory, and also runs hands-on DIY epoxy and woodworking workshops where participants leave with a finished piece.

Bear Naked Wood serves residential and commercial clients, including homeowners, restaurants, offices, and retail spaces. Customers are involved from slab selection through finish choices, and the company handles both one-off centerpiece tables and larger custom installations.

The company emphasizes real wood, real craftsmanship, and no shortcuts, positioning each piece as a lasting investment built from nature and made to last for generations.
